report.title: Reporting foundation in place
report.raw:
## What moved
- The activity report now has a formal, versioned shape that every downstream reader checks against.
- Publishing gained a switch that keeps each project's reports in order.
## What is next
- Wire the nightly run so the first real report lands this week.
